The precise global optimal spread passes through maximal/interior/zero regimes, sharpening qualitative epidemic-heterogeneity observations into two exact algebraic boundaries and a unique optimum across all transmissibilities. This is a motivated complete constrained classification rather than a numerical sampling or isolated parameter value.
